name: Venis
source:
Venis is the Kuonji head maid and Shinra's personal attendant. She is known to have a violent short temper. Her name sounds similar to "penis". This is shown to greatly aggravate her when the Uesugi siblings make fun of it.

[Based on [url=https://en.m.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Kimi_ga_Aruji_de_Shitsuji_ga_Ore_de&diffonly=true]Wikipedia[/url]]
